summary: The retained rolling-cart geometry repair correctly closes caster ground/chassis contact and mass/COM, but the two authored shelves still have no manufacturable load path to the chassis: both declare supportKeys={"chassis"} while their physical boxes are separated from the chassis by large empty vertical gaps and the genome contains no posts/frame members bridging those gaps. This is already acknowledged as separate shelf/frame manufacturability debt in independent PR #352 reviews, but no dedicated lane exists for it.
evidence: Inspected retained cart repair PR #352 exact head 0c458fdfcef07e86e3dc180e956a899d7cfb1da1 rather than current main, so the finding does not rediscover the already-fixed caster/COM defects.

At that reviewed head the chassis spans local Y [-0.370,-0.290] m. The lower shelf spans [-0.105,-0.055] m, leaving 0.185 m of empty space above the chassis, yet lower-shelf declares supportKeys={"chassis"}.
The upper shelf spans local Y [0.255,0.305] m and also declares supportKeys={"chassis"}; there is no authored upright/post/frame component between either shelf and the chassis.
Independent reviews on PR #352 explicitly preserve the pre-recorded shelf/frame manufacturability debt as out of scope while approving only caster contact and COM closure.
The live lane catalog contains HG-PHYSICS-CART-GEOMETRY and its superseded duplicate, but no separate cart shelf/frame manufacturability lane.
No Roblox Studio or engine evidence is implicated; this is a source-only ObjectGenome construction-grammar gap and must not be used to claim articulated cart behavior.

metadata.recommendedNext: After HG-PHYSICS-CART-GEOMETRY integrates, add a bounded source-only successor that authors a real frame/upright load path from the grounded chassis to both shelves, rewires supportKeys to contacting supports, advances the cart family version, recomputes mass/COM, and adds deterministic contact/support-graph regressions.
